title: Bought brown look black
text: Bought brown look black. We bought the light brown/mud colored balloons and they don’t look brown at all. Very dark and look black u less blown completely all the way up-and then they look kind of dark brown. Not at all as pictured. It was a quality balloon otherwise and didn’t pop easily.

product_metadata.title: Latex Party Balloons - 12", Amethyst Purple, 10 Pcs
features: PACKAGE INCLUDES: 10 latex party balloons; 12" when fully inflated
SOLID COLOR: Create a radiant and eye-catching decoration using these balloons that feature a solid Amethyst Purple color.
FOR ALL OCCASION: These balloons are suitable for birthdays, parties, baptisms, Christmas, holidays, or any themed events and celebrations
FINE QUALITY: Made from fine quality latex material that is easy to inflate with air or helium
OTHER COLORS: Search for more balloons from our wide variety of colors
description: Whether it's for a birthday party, a homecoming event, baptism, Christmas party, or any holiday celebration, you'll be able to create wonderful decors with these 12-inch Latex Balloons by Unique Industries! Each set includes 10 Latex Party Balloons that can measure up to 12 inches per balloon when inflated. Package comes uninflated when shipped. Create your very own radiant balloon arch for your guests to walk through, a table centerpiece, a hanged decor, and a lot more!
